blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The Puerto Princesa City Water District (PPCWD) is considering cloud seeding to augment the city’s water supply as it prepares for the potentially worsening impact of the prevailing “Super El Niño.” The Bureau of Soils and Water Management of the Department of Agriculture (DA-BSWM) had recommended cloud seeding following its initial assessment of the city’s water situation, said PPCWD General Manager Walter Laurel in a report from the Philippine Information Agency (PIA) office in Palawan. Laurel said the water district was considering the measure partly due to the high cost of hauling water to residents when supply levels drop. […]...
